description: This PHP source file implements a web service function 'vtws_sync' for synchronizing records between client and server in the vtiger CRM system. It handles retrieving updated and deleted records of specific modules based on modification times, permissions, and user roles.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class representing user entities, used for access control checks.

classes.name: WebServiceException
classes.description: Exception class used for handling web service related errors.

classes.name: EntityMeta
classes.description: Entity metadata class providing information and permissions for module entities.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating SQL query components for module data retrieval.

methods.name: vtws_sync
methods.description: Main web service function that performs data synchronization, retrieving updated and deleted records based on modification times and user permissions.

methods.name: vtws_getSeconds
methods.description: Converts modification time string to seconds since epoch for comparison.

methods.name: vtws_isRecordDeleted
methods.description: Determines whether a retrieved record is marked as deleted based on delete column values.

methods.name: vtws_getEmailFromClause
methods.description: Provides the FROM clause for email-related queries.

methods.name: getSyncQueryBaseTable
methods.description: Returns the base table or join clause for synchronization queries based on module type.

methods.name: getCalendarTypeCondition
methods.description: Returns the SQL condition to filter calendar activities based on their type (Task or Event).
